description: Verify official FP4 model variants ahead of installation, save them as package data and have installer/runtime consume static results without probing.

acceptance_criteria: Inventory every unique model ID and role across all tiers, including preprocessing, background/subagents, fast, heavy, reasoning, general, vision and conditional max 32B.
For every unique model, locate an exact NVFP4 checkpoint or produce one from the same base weights as its Q4 comparator; record immutable revisions/digests.
Run same-model FP4 versus Q4 inference with identical prompts, settings and supported backend for every feasible pair; score correctness/quality and record latency/VRAM.
Do not compare different model versions, sizes or runtimes as a pure quantization A/B; label any necessary backend differences and their limits.
Use only approved model downloads/conversions; user authorized all required FP4 assets and conversions for this evaluation.
Record all model IDs, sources, digests, runtimes, prompts, scores, measurements, unsupported cases and recommendations in a reviewable evaluation artifact and catalog.
task_fp4_inventory.blocker: 14B strict quantization-only comparison is unverified: a community checkpoint ilessio-aiflowlab/Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct-NVFP4-anima revision 93ea0239bcc734939d2b320b0f78c651e44df070 was converted and measured with llama.cpp against Ollama Q4_K_M. Provisional result: quality 8/8 both, median client throughput Q4 79.43 vs NVFP4 72.54 tok/s (NVFP4 8.7% slower); exact upstream revisions are missing on both artifacts. Local ModelOpt export of the pinned 14B base also failed on this Windows host. MiniCPM-V source is gated behind contact-sharing agreement. Conditional 32B exceeds 16GB VRAM; surfaced name-only candidate says INT4 weight-only, not NVFP4. Local ModelOpt 0.48 + Transformers 5.24.0 smaller-model results remain exploratory/untested combination.
task_fp4_inventory.description: Evaluate configured Q4 model artifacts against same-source NVFP4 across every tier model-role pair. Use identical prompts and generation settings. Distinguish measured quality from cross-runtime speed; NF4 is only an optional CUDA diagnostic, not the product Q4 comparator or proof of native FP4 acceleration.
task_fp4_inventory.next_action: For a strict 14B A/B obtain both Q4 and NVFP4 tied to one exact upstream revision and rerun same-runtime evaluation. MiniCPM needs an operator-authorized source or approval of its contact-sharing gate. Conditional 32B needs a verified NVFP4 artifact and larger GPU/runtime. Keep route catalog unchanged until full all-role coverage and quality criteria pass.
task_fp4_inventory.title: Run all-tier FP4 versus Q4 evaluation
